stem.text: Two spheres are released from rest at equal heights above the ground.
One sphere has a larger density than the other sphere.
Which statement is correct while both spheres are at terminal velocity?

A.text: The drag forces on the spheres are equal.

B.text: The resultant forces on the spheres are equal.

C.text: The velocities of the spheres are equal.

D.text: The weights of the spheres are equal.
